mapper.select: SELECT noti_id AS "id",noti_type_cd AS "typeCode",noti_cn AS "content",send_mthd_cd AS "sendMethodCode", read_yn='Y' AS "read",read_dttm AS "readAt",noti_dttm AS "notifiedAt", CASE WHEN link_scrn_id ~ '^UI-[0-9]{2}$' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_menu m WHERE m.scrn_id=n.link_scrn_id AND m.use_yn='Y') THEN link_scrn_id END AS "screenId",link_key AS "linkKey" FROM tb_sy_noti n WHERE ORDER BY noti_dttm DESC,noti_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT job_cd AS "jobCode",run_dt AS "runDate",state_cd AS "state",last_step::int AS "lastStep", start_dttm AS "startedAt",end_dttm AS "endedAt",error_cn AS "errorMessage" FROM tb_sy_automation_run ORDER BY run_dt DESC,job_cd ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
